title: Sliding Window
intuition: Maintain a contiguous subsegment (window) using two pointers. Shift the boundaries to scan all valid contiguous ranges.
recognition_signals: Seeking minimum, maximum, or target properties of subarrays
step_by_step_strategy: Initialize left and right boundaries at 0.
Expand right pointer to include elements.
When window condition is violated, advance left pointer to shrink the window.
Update maximum/minimum tracking at each valid window position.
common_mistakes: Updating global minimums inside invalid window loops
complexity: Time: O(n), Space: O(1) or O(k)
content: Maintain a contiguous subsegment (window) using two pointers. Shift the boundaries to scan all valid contiguous ranges.
